note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh); it carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations (much of this book quotes the Song of Solomon) are self_rendered in the 1962 register.
The mirror lacks some verses or holds them under a neighbouring number (e.g. Revelation 15:3-4, Hebrews 11:26, Colossians 1:19, Acts 13:39, Luke 24:34); those quotations are self_rendered.
